messages:
Maya K.: Hey team — draft blog post + webinar landing copy is up: https://docs.google.com/xxx. Need quick review within 24h. Main asks: CTA wording, benchmark phrasing (we say '3x latency/cost'), webinar sign-up gating vs open RSVP, and HubSpot lead routing/UTM. Also legal check on the privacy line.

Tom R.: reading now. quick thoughts: CTA options — 'Register for the launch webinar' / 'Save my spot' / 'See it live'. I like 'Save my spot' for conversion. Subject line options for email:
- 'See how Redwood cuts inference cost — Live demo'
- 'Join the Redwood launch: faster inference, lower cost'

Tom R.: Proposed UTM for CTA (example):
`?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=launch_2025&utm_content=webinar_cta`

Priya S.: quick legal flags: we need a short consent sentence on the form: "By registering you agree to receive product updates from Redwood." Also add: "We process your data according to our Privacy Policy" with link. For Private customers mention: "If you are a Redwood Private customer, your contact info will not be exported without consent."

Lucas G.: growth note — prefer gated form (email + company) for webinar so we can route leads into HubSpot lists and trigger the path. Add hidden field `origin=blog_launch` and `utm_content=webinar_landing` so we can segment. Also ask product to include a short qualifier question: "Are you evaluating inference infra? (Y/N)"

Jason L.: engineering QA on benchmarks: please soften to "up to 3x" and add a short footnote: "Benchmark: internal tail-latency test, 8xA100 equivalence, 2k token median, synthetic traffic. See benchmarks tab in the repo." Concrete sentence we can paste: "In our internal tests, Redwood delivered up to 3x lower per-token latency compared to baseline X on comparable hardware (see benchmark notes)."

Maya K.: copying the suggested changes into the doc now. Updated hero CTA to 'Save my spot' and added the consent line Priya suggested. Added hidden fields and UTM snippet from Tom and Lucas. Leaving benchmark copy as Jason's "up to 3x" + footnote.

DriveBot: Google Drive — Document "launch-blog-webinar-draft" was updated by Maya K. (https://docs.google.com/xxx)

Priya S.: Approve legal on the short consent text. One tiny edit: replace "exported" with "shared" in the Private customer line. Otherwise good :white_check_mark:

Tom R.: +1 on wording. small ask — can we include one pager link for sales in the CTA flow (hidden field sales=true if they check "Contact me")? That helps routing for enterprise leads.

Lucas G.: I'll map the form in HubSpot tonight: `form_id=WB-2025-launch`; routing: if `sales=true` route to Enterprise SDR queue, else to Marketing nurture. Also will set UTM filters in GA.

Jason L.: Approved benchmark phrasing. Suggest we add a link to the benchmark notebook in the footnote: `https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/webinar-launch`

Maya K.: Amazing, thanks. I'll lock the doc at 18:00 PT and hand off to ops for publish + email. Final checklist: copy locked, legal approved, HubSpot form mapped, webinar calendar + registrant emails set. If no objections I'll schedule publish tomorrow morning. :rocket:
